meaning:
1) to cease, come to an end
1a) (Qal) to come to an end
1b) (Hiphil) to make an end
Aramaic equivalent: suph (סוּף "be fulfilled" H5487)

renderings.bsb: I will take away their harvest
I will completely sweep away everything

elsewhere.note: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim…
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
“Those who sanctify themselves and purify themselves to go to the gardens, behind one in the middle, eating pig’s meat, abominable things, and the mouse, they…
“ ‘I will utterly consume them, says Yahweh. No grapes will be on the vine, no figs on the fig tree, and the leaf will fade. The things that I have given them…
I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth, says Yahweh.
